channel.title: 1. Internship Worklog :: Báo cáo AWS Workshop
channel.description: WEEKLY INTERNSHIP WORKLOG Program: Workforce Bootcamp - First Cloud AI Journey A detailed record of tasks, learning modules, training sessions, and achievements throughout the 12-week internship at AWS Vietnam. 12-Week Roadmap Summary: Week 1 - Week 4: Initialization, familiarization with the AWS environment, and research into foundational services (EC2, S3, Git, VPC). Week 5 - Week 8: Advanced infrastructure deployment (Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, RDS, Docker) and design of the Website project architecture. Week 9 - Week 12: System authorization (IAM Roles), optimization (CDN, CI/CD), finalization of project features, and completion of the internship report. Select a specific week from the left menu or click on the list below to view details.
